tool.name: BCFtools Index Statistics (from URL)
tool.description: Create CSI index and report index statistics from remote VCF/BCF

param.name: vcf_url
param.label: VCF/BCF URL (http/https/ftp)
param.help: Provide a direct link to a .vcf.gz or .bcf file accessible from the Galaxy server.

tool.help:
This tool downloads a **remote VCF or BCF file**, creates a **CSI index**, and reports **index statistics** using `bcftools`.
Input ----- - **VCF/BCF URL** – A direct link to a **.vcf.gz** or **.bcf** file accessible from the Galaxy server (HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP). - Sample data: https://3kricegenome.s3.dualstack.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/Nipponbare/snp-only-vcf/01_Nipponbare_IRIS_313-9996.snp.vcf.filtered.gz
Output ------ The output is a **tab-delimited text file with three columns** describing statistics for each contig in the indexed file:
1. **Contig name** The chromosome or sequence identifier (for example `chr1`, `chr2`, etc.).
2. **Contig length** The length of the contig in the reference genome. If the length is not known, a **'.'** may be reported.
3. **Number of records** The number of variant records indexed for that contig.
**Example output**::
chr1 248956422 15432 chr2 242193529 13210 chr3 198295559 11045
`Each row corresponds to one contig present in the indexed VCF/BCF file.`
Notes ----- - The **entire file is downloaded before indexing**. - Input files must already be **compressed (`.vcf.gz`) or in BCF format**. - The provided URL must be **directly accessible from the Galaxy server**.
